newsitem.title: UK: One Brent date kept, others in dispute - traders.
newsitem.headline: One Brent date kept, others in dispute - traders.

text.p: One of the five Brent dates turning wet on Friday was kept, while the others were still in dispute half an hour after the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
JP Morgan kept one cargo loading Feb 17-19, while the other four were in dispute between JP Morgan and Glencore, Stasco and Mobil, Stasco and BP, and Morgan Stanley and BP, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
